fields.title: Palau Business Registry entity search / profile record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Search-only records (fetchProfiles off, _source=S1-searchcorp) carry the lightweight SearchCorp fields; enriched records (_source=S1-searchcorp+profile or S2-profile-direct) additionally carry the full GetCorpProfile response spread at top level (Corp, Addresses, Activities, CorpFilings, Directors, Officers, Members/shareholders, ShareAllotments, Secretaries, Owners, BeneficialOwners, ...). Directors/Officers/Members/ShareAllotments/Addresses/CorpFilings come back populated for anonymous access on this registry; Secretaries/Owners/BeneficialOwners were empty on the entity tested.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term or CorpId that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-searchcorp (search result only), S1-searchcorp+profile (search result enriched with full profile), S2-profile-direct (profile fetched directly from an input CorpId), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions: not_found (nonexistent CorpId), no_results (search term matched nothing), or blocked_or_transient (network/token issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

CorpId.title: Entity ID
CorpId.description: Palau Registry internal GUID identifying this entity. Use as input in 'corpIds' for a direct profile lookup in a later run.

Name.title: Entity name
Name.description: Registered name, from the search result.

NameMatch.title: Matched name
NameMatch.description: The specific name value the search term matched against (may differ from Name on a prior-name match).

Type.title: Entity type
Type.description: Palau For Profit Corporation, Foreign For Profit Corporation, Palau Nonprofit Corporation, or Foreign Nonprofit Corporation (search result).

IsPriorRegistered.title: Was prior-registered
IsPriorRegistered.description: Whether this entity was registered under a prior system (search result).

PriorNames.title: Prior names
PriorNames.description: List of previous registered names, if any (search result).

BusinessActivities.title: Business activities
BusinessActivities.description: List of declared business activity categories (search result).

FormatedBusinessActivities.title: Business activities (formatted)
FormatedBusinessActivities.description: Comma-joined business activities string (search result; upstream field name spelled as-is).

RegisteredOfficerAddress.title: Registered office address
RegisteredOfficerAddress.description: Single-line registered office address (search result; frequently null -- see Corp.RegisteredOfficeAddress on profile records instead).

InactiveDateFormatted.title: Inactive date
InactiveDateFormatted.description: Date the entity became inactive, if applicable (search result).

ReportDueDateFormatted.title: Report due date
ReportDueDateFormatted.description: Annual report due date at time of search (search result).

TypeCode.title: Type code
TypeCode.description: Upstream type code field (search result; frequently null).

Corp.title: Entity detail
Corp.description: Full entity detail object from GetCorpProfile: CompanyName, RegistrationNumber, CompanyType, Status, RegistrationDateFormatted, RegisteredOfficeAddress, PostalAddress, TotalShares, TaxId, AnnualReturnDueDateFormatted, and ~40 more raw upstream fields. Only present on enriched/profile records.

Addresses.title: Addresses
Addresses.description: List of all address records on file (registered office, principal place of business, etc.) -- populated for anonymous access, profile records only.

Activities.title: Activities
Activities.description: List of declared business activity objects -- profile records only.

Directors.title: Directors
Directors.description: Director list with full name, nationality, appointment date, and residential address -- populated for anonymous access (no login needed), profile records only.

Officers.title: Officers
Officers.description: Officer list (e.g. President) with full name, nationality, appointment date, and residential address -- populated for anonymous access (no login needed), profile records only.

Members.title: Members / shareholders
Members.description: Shareholder/member list with full name, nationality, and address -- populated for anonymous access (no login needed), profile records only.

ShareAllotments.title: Share allotments
ShareAllotments.description: Share allotment records, each listing the shareholders it covers -- populated for anonymous access, profile records only.

Secretaries.title: Secretaries
Secretaries.description: Company secretary list -- empty on the entity tested for anonymous access; may require an authenticated account (not attempted by this actor).

Owners.title: Owners
Owners.description: Owner records -- empty on the entity tested for anonymous access; may require an authenticated account (not attempted by this actor).

BeneficialOwners.title: Beneficial owners
BeneficialOwners.description: Beneficial owner records -- empty on the entity tested for anonymous access; may require an authenticated account (not attempted by this actor).

Mortgages.title: Mortgages/charges
Mortgages.description: Registered mortgage/charge records against this entity, if any -- profile records only.

Documents.title: Documents
Documents.description: Filed document metadata list -- profile records only (frequently empty for anonymous access).

CorpFilings.title: Filings
CorpFilings.description: Accepted filing history, with type and date -- populated for anonymous access, profile records only.

IsAuthorized.title: Is authorized
IsAuthorized.description: Whether the requesting session is authenticated/authorized for full access. Always false for this actor (no-login policy).

IsLoggedin.title: Is logged in
IsLoggedin.description: Always false for this actor (no-login policy).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-only and enriched profile records.
